name: Algodonales (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Algodonales (flames on red, with the motto POR LA VERDAD Y POR LA PATRIA).
history: Municipal flag of Algodonales; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Algodonales arms — flames on red, with motto
